items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would go to the radio station and work with the two guys who were on staff. Walter Yost was the bass player. And Phil Schwartz, I think his name was.

ctx.x: And it would be shown at 5:00 the next day or something?

That was the other one. The other one was at the radio station. I would go to the radio station and work with the two guys who were on staff. Walter Yost was the bass player. And Phil Schwartz, I think his name was. These were two guys that . . . There was a lot of live . . .
Studio work at that time too.
